sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "SportsInfo"."StuID" AS e, AVG((CAST("SportsInfo"."GamesPlayed" AS REAL) / "SportsInfo"."HoursPerWeek")) AS m1 FROM "SportsInfo" GROUP BY "SportsInfo"."StuID"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
